start: A member with workouts over 4 months, on the Profile tab

user_sees: Page 'Calendar' with a search button
Card 'Streak' with a number, 'week' or 'weeks' and 'in a row'
Card 'Rest days' with 'day' or 'days' and 'since last workout'
Month and year switch and button 'Log a past workout'
Months with workout days marked
must_not: The two cards of different heights
A streak that differs from the Profile tab's streak

steps.action: Tap a day with one workout
user_sees: That workout's page opens
must_not: A sheet with one card for a one-workout day

steps.action: Go back and tap a day with two workouts
user_sees: A sheet titled with the date and year, the count of workouts and one card each
must_not: 'No workout that day.' on a marked day

user_sees: 'Back to your first workout, <date with year>.'
must_not: Months before the first workout

steps.action: Switch to Year, tap a month
user_sees: The month view scrolled to that month
must_not: The list left at the top or at the wrong month

user_sees: The Calendar page
must_not: The Profile tab instead

start: Calendar page, a member who did squats last month

user_sees: Title 'Search workouts', box 'Search workouts', 'Type an exercise or a workout name.'
must_not: The keyboard covering the results

user_sees: 'Searching…', then matching workouts, and at the end 'That’s every match.'
must_not: Workouts that do not hold squats

user_sees: 'No workouts match “zzzz”'
must_not: An empty white list with no words

user_sees: The calendar again (search closes first)
must_not: The page closing on the first back

start: Calendar page, no workout open, a member who forgot to log yesterday's workout

user_sees: Sheet 'Log a past workout' with 'Pick the day, when it started and how long it lasted.'
Start hour, start minute, length in minutes and 'Which routine?' chips with 'None'
must_not: Today's date picked by default when the member chose yesterday

steps.action: Pick yesterday, 18:30, 60 minutes, routine Push 1, tap 'Log <date> · 18:30'
user_sees: The workout screen for the past workout, with Push 1's exercises
must_not: The workout dated today

steps.action: Finish it and come back to Calendar
user_sees: Yesterday marked; the streak and rest days updated
must_not: The day marked twice or not at all

start: Log a past workout sheet open

user_sees: 'Type the start time.'
must_not: The log button working with no time

user_sees: 'Type how long it lasted.'
must_not: A workout of 0 minutes

steps.action: Pick today and a start time later than now
user_sees: A line that the start cannot be in the future
must_not: A workout saved in the future

steps.action: With a workout already open, tap the log button
user_sees: A question offering to resume it, or 'Discard it and log the past one'
must_not: The open workout thrown away without asking

start: A brand-new member with no workouts

user_sees: Streak 0 weeks
Rest days '—' with 'no workouts yet'
'Workouts you log show on these days.' at the end
must_not: Rest days counted from 1970 or as a huge number

steps.action: Log a first workout, delete it later from its page, come back
user_sees: The day no longer marked; Rest days back to 'no workouts yet'
must_not: A deleted workout still marked or counted in the streak
